question: The famous ‘Sriharikota’ island of India is well known as _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**a space-centre**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The f**amous Sriharikota island of India is known as a space centre**
 
• Sriharikota **is home to the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), India's primary satellite launch centre and spaceport.**
 
• The** SDSC is a lead centre of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). **
 
• **Sriharikota is a long, narrow island in the Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, India.**
 
• It's located between the Bay of Bengal and Pulicat Lake. 
 
• Strategic location
 
• Sriharikota's proximity to the equator makes it a strategically important location for space launches. 
 
• Sriharikota has a tropical wet and dry climate with hot summers and mild winters. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ISRO is the space agency under the Department of Space of Government of India, headquartered in the city of Bengaluru, Karnataka.
 
• It was established by Jawaharlal Nehru in 1962 under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE).
 
• Eminent scientist Dr Vikram Sarabhai had a big role in this development.
 
• The INCOSPAR became ISRO in 1969.
 
• ISRO Chairman: Dr. S Somanath
